articles.summary: For David and his mother, Melissa, moments of joy are an important part of life with Alexander disease (AxD), an ultra-rare, progressive and often fatal neurological disorder that affects approximately 1 in 1 to 3 million people worldwide.
articles.title: Finding Joy in the Journey: David and Melissa’s Life with Alexander disease (AxD)

articles.summary: Beth’s recognition reflects more than 25 years of leadership at Ionis. As a member of the executive leadership team, she has helped guide the company’s transformation from an organization focused primarily on research and early development into a fully integrated commercial-stage biotech.
articles.title: Ionis’ CFO Beth Hougen Named 2026 CFO of the Year by San Diego Business Journal

articles.summary: When triglyceride levels reach 500 mg/dL or higher, the risks of serious complications like acute pancreatitis and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease can increase. Watch as people living with sHTG share their experiences and reveal the often-misunderstood realities of living with this serious condition.
articles.title: The Misunderstood Realities of Living with Very High Triglycerides
